def: Safeguards for open-weight models designed to survive adversarial fine-tuning, such as tamper-resistant training or filtering hazardous knowledge out of the pretraining data.
practice: Ordinary refusal training can be removed with a few fine-tuning steps; Deep Ignorance's filtered 6.9B models resisted up to 10,000 steps of biothreat fine-tuning but could still use dangerous facts supplied in context.
